title: Become Gurmukh, And Extinguish The Fire Within
summary: Doubt is being answered in the middle of pressure, not after the day has calmed down.
takeaway: The fire of doubt is not extinguished, even by wandering through foreign; o mind, become Gurmukh, and extinguish the fire within
lifeApplication: Return to one clear line before reopening every question at once. Use the line before the pressure chooses your tone.

source.lifeApplication: Let the wider line hold together what the mind wants to split apart.
